description:
Read a public https page for an agent: the main content as clean Markdown (headings, lists, tables kept; navigation, cookie banners, scripts and everything hidden from humans removed), scrubbed by the input guard — instructions aimed at the model replaced, invisible Unicode stripped — with verdict, score, findings, title and language. JSON and text pass through. One GET as a declared bot, no login or bot-protection bypass; a blocked page is never charged. 0.02 USDC base (new payers 0.02, >10 payments 0.014; 1 pack call).
After: preflight before your agent buys or pays anything the page offers (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Token from buy_signal_pack, buy_subscription (pro/desk) or buy_enterprise instead of paying per call.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from: the payment-required error quotes your tier (0 payments base price (new-payer surcharge paused), 1-10 base, >10 -30 %) and, from the third payment, an upgrade with your own spend.

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

url.description: the public https page to read (1 MB, 10 s)

name: stealth_read
title: Read any URL as clean, injection-scrubbed Markdown for an LLM
